# Vocabulary.com

> > An interactive English dictionary and vocabulary learning platform featuring adaptive learning technology, word games, and educational tools for students and teachers.

Vocabulary.com combines a comprehensive English dictionary with personalized learning algorithms to help users master vocabulary through engaging activities like Vocabulary Bowl and Vocab Jam competitions. The platform serves both individual learners and educational institutions with tools for vocabulary improvement and assessment.
